title: tune-nccl-stream-priorities-and-overlap-for-tensor-parallel-collectives
author: Alex Martinez
commits: a1f3b2c: add per-collective stream tagging and priority annotations
b7d9e4f: implement priority-aware NCCL ops in nccl_manager
c3e2d1a: introduce stream_scheduler to avoid unnecessary syncs
d4f6b7c: KV cache shard non-blocking fetch for tensor-parallel path
e5a8c9d: add microbench and perf harness for overlap measurements
f6b1e2a: add metrics for nccl wait time and scheduling counters
g7c2d3b: docs and helm values for TP tuning
h8d3e4c: fix test flakiness and adjust CI thresholds
description: Motivation: Multi-GPU tensor-parallel collectives were creating high synchronization overheads in common seq-len workloads, causing tail latency spikes and reduced throughput. This PR tunes NCCL stream usage and scheduling to improve overlap between comms and kernel compute and removes several implicit global sync points. Summary of changes: 1) Add per-collective stream tagging in runtime/tensor_parallel/nccl_manager to allow different classes of collectives (reduce-scatter, all-gather, all-reduce) to be dispatched on separate CUDA streams with configurable priorities; 2) Implement a lightweight stream_scheduler that sequences kernel launches and collective dispatches to avoid unnecessary cudaDeviceSynchronize calls and to prefer compute streams when possible; 3) Expose NCCL operation priority settings and defaults based on model size and batch characteristics; 4) Make KV cache shard fetch non-blocking on the tensor-parallel path by allowing local async prefetches and deferring cross-device synchronization until necessary; 5) Add microbench harness and integration test measuring overlap and per-collective wait time; 6) Add observability metric nccl_wait_time and scheduling counters to help diagnose regressions. Performance: On internal tp-8xA100 throughput improved 12-25% depending on batch size and seq length; p99 token latency reduced ~15% on long-context tests; NCCL waiting time reduced by up to 40% in synthetic overlap benches. Risk and compatibility: default behavior preserves existing ordering and priorities; changes are opt-in via config flags in redwood-helm-charts and runtime config. Checklist: - [x] Add per-collective stream tagging and priority handling; - [x] Implement stream scheduler and integrate with kernel launcher; - [x] KV cache non-blocking prefetch for TP path; - [x] Add benchmarks and integration tests; - [x] Update docs and helm values; - [x] Run full CI and perf job. Related: ENG-1428 (tensor-parallel perf initiative), SUP-9821 (customer report of TP tail latency).

Maya Chen: Tests look good. Observability metrics will help ops. Please add a note to docs about tuning knobs and recommended defaults per GPU family.

release_notes: Improve multi-GPU tensor-parallel performance by tuning NCCL stream priorities and removing unnecessary syncs; adds runtime flag to control behavior and observability metrics for NCCL wait times. Expected throughput uplift for TP workloads and reduced tail latency.
